description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view called WatchInboxView, which displays an inbox message interface for an Apple Watch extension. It constructs the UI based on data from a WatchInboxStore, including title, body, details, actions, reply status, and update time.

classes.name: WatchInboxView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays inbox message content with actions, details, and metadata tailored for Apple Watch.

methods.name: role(for:)
methods.description: Determines the ButtonRole (destructive, cancel, or default) based on the action's style string. It processes and trims the style string, then matches it in a case-insensitive manner.
